name: fungus-games
description: Three mobile games: Humongous Fungus (idle terrarium), Sporemonger (mushroom market trading) and Sugar Crash (a crash game for play money).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && GAME=fungus vite build && GAME=sporemonger vite build && GAME=sugarcrash vite build
scripts.build:artifact: npm run build && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs fungus && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs sporemonger && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs sugarcrash
